question.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> are converted to mono cations <math><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msubsup></math> and <math><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msubsup></math> respectively. The wrong statement with respect to given changes in the following is

options.text: the O – O bond order increases
the <math><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> bond length decreases

solution.text:
B.O or N2=3 and N2+=2.5

As here bond order decreases so N-N bond get weak N2+ becomes paramagnetic
In case of O2 and O2+
B.O or O2=2 and O2+=2.5
as bond order increases so O-O bond length decreases.
